statusDetail: The raw-CDP Chrome session consistently failed navigation with ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR. The run stopped at recon as required; no quality verdicts or score are published.

page.notes: Origin page did not load in Chrome. HTTP/1.1 curl reached the nginx/Express/Akamai edge, but rendered architecture and templates could not be inspected.

artifacts.caption: Desktop raw-CDP capture showing Chrome ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR.
Mobile raw-CDP capture of the same transport failure.
DOM primitive output from Chrome error page, not the redBus origin document.
Evaluate probe proving location was chrome-error://chromewebdata/ with ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR.
HTTP/1.1 curl headers showing the edge is reachable outside Chrome.
robots.txt fetched over HTTP/1.1 for limited route recon.
Pinned Modern Web Guidance 0.0.172 catalog list cached before judgement.
Atomic 58-check coverage manifest and per-check evidence plan.
artifacts.condition: exact principles.json used for this run

artifacts.caption: Atomic coverage validator output. It records 58 blocked checks and rejects completion.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted raw-CDP navigation with the dom, screenshot, and evaluate primitives at desktop and 360x800; Chrome failed before the origin document loaded with ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR.
checkOutcomes.evidence: External transport failure: Chrome returned ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR and loaded chrome-error://chromewebdata/ instead of the redBus origin document. HTTP/1.1 curl could reach the edge, confirming the URL exists, but cannot substitute for browser-rendered, interactive evidence.
